entities.text: HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Advocate Mr. Pinank Raiyani for Mr. Hriday Buch, learned advocate for the applicant submits that, no defence was raised under section 80 of the Food, Safety and Standard Act, 2006 before the adjudicating officer and for the first time such ground was raised before the appellate tribunal.

Mr.
Raiyani submitted that the order of fine was laid down on the accused.

2. Considering the submissions and the grounds R/CR.MA/21704/2022 ORDER DATED:
07/12/2022 raised, leave to appeal, is granted.
